summary: Frontend testing of CompatibilityCard on /bem-estar/horoscopo. Age gate works. Both tabs ('Por signo' and 'Sinastria completa') render with all expected data-testids. Sign-mode returns AI reading with score. FULL sinastria (POST /api/horoscope/compat/full) returns a result with score, summary and Mestre Agnes badge. FOCUS REGRESSION verified: typing 'Maria da Silva' char-by-char in compat-p1-nome kept focus on the same input and produced the full value — PersonFields extraction outside the component fixed the bug. Submit button correctly disabled until both birth dates are filled.
critical_code_review_comments: CompatibilityCard.jsx: solid. PersonFields correctly declared at module scope (fix for focus loss). Consider adding min/max on date inputs to prevent unrealistic dates (future dates are currently accepted).

Result payload uses `official` flag; when false the badge text falls back to 'Atualizado por Mestre Agnes' — good UX. In EN i18n verify the key 'horoscope.agnes.updated_by' still contains 'Agnes' branding (badge visual OK in screenshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compat flow validated end-to-end. Key testids: compatibility-card, compat-mode-sign, compat-mode-birth, compat-sign1/2, compat-analyse-btn, compat-p{1,2}-{nome,data,hora,cidade,uf}, compat-full-btn, compat-result, compat-score, compat-error, compat-official-text. When Agnes API is offline the response returns official:false and renders reading.summary/strengths/challenges/advice; when official:true it renders compat-official-text.

test_evidence.focus_regression: PASS — value='Maria da Silva', activeElement stayed on compat-p1-nome
